content.title: 7 Juicy Bombshells from the 'Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special'
content.text: Miley Cyrus and Hannah Montana cast members celebrate the premiere of the "Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special" on March 23, 2026 in Los Angeles, California. Credit : Frank Micelotta/Disney via Getty NEED TO KNOW Miley Cyrus reflected on her days on Hannah Montana in the Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary SpecialThe pop star spoke at length about her past crushes, relationships and friendships with fellow Disney Channel starsIn addition to Cyrus, the special also included interviews with Selena Gomez and Chappell Roan Miley Cyrus spilled some serious tea while reflecting on the glory days of Hannah Montana. The beloved Disney Channel sitcom, which premiered 20 years ago, famously launched the career of Cyrus, who was just 13 years old at the time. She iconically starred as the popstar Hannah Montana who took on a private identity as Miley Stewart to live a normal life. The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special was released on Disney+ and Hulu on March 24. The "Hannahversary" featured in-depth interviews with Cyrus about behind-the-scenes details, surprise guest appearances and even included a performance of a new song. From her secret Disney crushes to how some of her fellow child stars came to appear on Hannah Montana, Cyrus didn't hold back on spilling some of the secrets fans have been wanting to know for years. Here's everything to know about the biggest bombshells from the Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special. Cyrus dated Dylan Sprouse while filming Hannah Montana Dylan Sprouse, Miley Cyrus and Cole Sprouse at the 2007 Power of Youth on October 6, 2007 in Universal City, California. Chris Polk/WireImage As part of the 20th anniversary special, Cyrus sat down with Call Her Daddy podcast host Alex Cooper and reflected on starring in Hannah Montana, which ran from 2006 to 2011. During their conversation, Cyrus revealed that she "secretly" dated fellow Disney child actor and The Suite Life of Zack & Cody star, Dylan Sprouse. "Secretly, okay, Dylan Sprouse was my boyfriend. I think he was the cutest," Cyrus divulged. "Dylan was my crush." Cyrus recalled going on dates with Dylan — whose brother, Cole Sprouse, starred alongside him in their hit show — accompanied by his dad and Cole. "Their dad would take us to sushi," she added. "I was into the whole culture, and it was a two-for-one. Like, bring the brother. Hello!” The "Flowers" singer, who worked with Dylan and Cole in the 2006 crossover special That’s So Suite Life of Hannah Montana, confirmed the rumors after Dylan previously teased the romance in 2008. During an appearance on Jimmy Kimmel Live!, Dylan insinuated he was previously "kind of relatively" dating Cyrus when they were both young teens. “We met at her set, I believe, and we dated,” he joked, before referring to her future romance with Nick Jonas and said, “And then Nick Jonas walked by and it was over.” Hannah Montana got a Taylor Swift cameo because they knew she'd be comfortable performing "in a barn" Taylor Swift and Miley Cyrus on the set of 'Hannah Montana: The Movie' (2009). Alamy For true Hannah Montana fans, it's not a surprise that Taylor Swift played a significant role in the creation of the 2009 film, Hannah Montana: The Movie. Swift famously appeared in the movie to sing her original song "Crazier" during a romantic barn dance scene. However, the way the filmmakers worked with Swift to secure her performance — as well as the song Swift co-wrote and Cyrus performed, "You'll Always Find Your Way Back Home" — was not previously known. "For that scene, get the tea kettle," Cyrus shared. "So the way that Taylor Swift ended up in the Hannah Montana movie was because this was kind of the beginning of her career, and they were looking for someone that would authentically — no shade — I guess, be performing in a barn. We both performed in the barn." As for the finale song, "You'll Always Find Your Way Back Home," Cyrus called the track a "banger" that "stands the test of time." "She ate with that one," Cyrus concluded. Cyrus chose the Jonas Brothers to open for her on tour, because she was dating Nick Jonas at the time Miley Cyrus performs with Nick Jonas, Kevin Jonas and Joe Jonas of Jonas Brothers during her 'Best of Both Worlds' tour on December 27, 2007 in Uniondale, New York. Kevin Mazur/WireImage Shortly after Cyrus skyrocketed to fame in 2006, she began dating Nick Jonas, who was just getting his start with Joe and Kevin Jonas as the Jonas Brothers. Cyrus and Nick, who earned the nickname "Niley," dated from around 2006 to 2007. Around that same time, Cyrus embarked on her first major tour, the "Best of Both Worlds Tour," and purposely requested that Nick and his brothers open for her. "Literally, the reason that the Jonas Brothers were on tour with me was because Nick was my boyfriend, and I wanted to not leave my boyfriend," Cyrus spilled. "So I'd be like, 'Okay, well, I'll go on tour if my boyfriend can come.' And they're like, 'Cute, have your boyfriend open for the show.' Boom." In addition to performing a few of their original songs before Cyrus took the stage, the Jonas Brothers also performed their duet with her, "We Got the Party," during the tour. The Disney couple ultimately called it quits in late 2007, and they both went on to date other celebrities but have remained on good terms. Cyrus had crushes on Mitchell Musso and Zac Efron Miley Cyrus and Mitchel Musso at the premiere of "Monster House" on July 17, 2006 in Westwood, California ; Zac Efron and Miley Cyrus at the 18th Annual MTV Movie Awards on May 31, 2009 in Los Angeles, California. Michael Buckner/Getty ; Frank Micelotta/Getty Beyond Cyrus' relationships, she also had a few crushes on her other Disney friends. Shortly after she was cast as Hannah Montana and left Tennessee to film the series, she developed a crush on her costar Mitchel Musso, who played her on-screen best friend, Oliver. "I thought Mitchel Musso was really cute," Cyrus recalled. "It's all about Mitchell now. I was like, 'Great! Crush. I'm good now. I'm set up.' " Another person who Cyrus had a crush on was fellow Disney star Zac Efron, who had made a name for himself in the High School Musical franchise. She remembered befriending Efron and his on-screen and off-screen girlfriend, Vanessa Hudgens. During one press trip to New York, she drove with the couple and thought it was the "coolest thing ever." However, she clarified that she didn't have a crush on Efron until later on and said she liked him when he was "ripped, a little older." Selena Gomez mainly remembered feeling "ugly" while making a Hannah Montana cameo Selena Gomez and Miley Cyrus during the 2008 Teen Choice Awards on August 3, 2008 in Los Angeles, California. K Mazur/TCA 2008/WireImage Just months before Selena Gomez became known for her role as Alex Russo on the Disney sitcom Wizards of Waverly Place in 2007, she played the recurring role of Hannah Montana's popstar nemesis, Mikayla, on Hannah Montana. Gomez, who has remained good friends with Cyrus, reunited with her for the 20th anniversary special. When asked what she remembered about filming, Gomez admitted that one thing stuck out: her makeup. "I remember being in that blue, weird makeup," Gomez said of her costume. "I remember feeling ugly in that. Because we’re, like, 15 and I want to feel pretty, and I'm like, 'Ugh.' " The two friends also reflected on their characters' "pretty mean" rivalry and joked that they've made "amends" since. Chappell Roan made a surprise appearance and said that Hannah "walked so I could run" Miley Cyrus attends the Premiere of the "Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special" on March 23, 2026 in Los Angeles, California ; Chappell Roan attends the 2025 Met Gala on May 05, 2025 in New York City. Amy Sussman/Getty ; John Shearer/WireImage In a surprise cameo, Chappell Roan — who has been a vocal fan of Cyrus' for years — met the singer for the first time. The "Pink Pony Club" artist took the opportunity to thank Cyrus for helping set her up for success and paving the way for female artists. "I’m so grateful that I get to be a part of this. I mean I grew up watching Hannah at my grandparents’ house and it just means so much,” Roan said. She added, "What I do onstage or where I can go on a red carpet and just be ... that’s because you took a lot of the heat for that in 2012, 2013. I don’t have to deal with that as much because the world took it out on you." The Grammy winner told Cyrus that she "literally walked so I could run" and referenced how Cyrus grew up in the public eye. “To see you be the artist you are, to be able to do this, just shows your heart and your appreciation for your younger self and what got you here,” Roan shared. Cyrus thanked Roan and explained that the whole point of the anniversary special was to look back and love "on our younger selves, knowing that my younger me worked so hard so I could have the life that I have now.” Cyrus performed a new song at the end of the special Miley Cyrus during the Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special on March 23, 2026 in Los Angeles, California. Ser Baffo/Disney While Cyrus candidly spoke about her experience on the show and reflected on lifelong memories for the special, she also used the moment to reprise her Hannah Montana role again and sing several of her hit songs. In addition to belting out some of Hannah's beloved songs, she also surprised fans with a new tune titled "Younger You," that she dedicated to the show and her child self. "It’s been an honor to celebrate 20 years with Hannah Montana, and I’ve looked back at every memory with a heart full of love. Hannah, she gave me my start, but my fans gave me this life," she concluded in the special.
